q: What is the current stock price of AAPL?
gt: No share price can be served for AAPL, because the keyless quote sources available all bar redistribution or commercial use of their prices.
a: No stock price is served by this miner. Every keyless quote source we read either bars redistribution of its prices or bars commercial use, so publishing a figure from one would breach its terms. Crypto prices, exchange rates, protocol TVL and on-chain figures are served.
